opening.argument: The presentation promotes automatic Bitcoin trading while representing that members’ holdings can increase steadily, including an asserted average of 1.5% daily since August 2019. It directs viewers to create an account, fund it with Bitcoin, and wait for trading to begin automatically while their Bitcoin grows. The offer also ties compensation to recruitment: qualifying for a Binary Bitcoin Commission requires referring two people, placing them on left and right legs, and building a team. With binary commissions generated through team building, the opportunity combines a claimed daily return with funded participation and tiered referral payouts.
